newsitem.title: USA: A.M.Best gives A ratings to Kingsway subs.
newsitem.headline: A.M.Best gives A ratings to Kingsway subs.

text.p: Insurance rating agency A.M. Best said Tuesday it assigned A ("excellent") ratings to two Kingsway Financial Services Inc companies, York Fire & Casualty Insurance Co and Kingsway General Insurance Co.
A.M. Best said Kingsway General's initial A rating reflects its position as a leading provider of car insurance in Canada and support from its parent Kingsway Financial.

The rating agency said Kingsway General has about C$166 million in assets and C$34.3 million policy holders' surplus. It said Kingsway returned 30.3 percent on the surplus in 1996 and increased its gross premium receipts by 127 percent.
It added the positive factors were offset by the competitive Canadian car insurance market; the company's 2.4 leverage ratio; and uncertainty about regulatory changes that may increase claims.
A.M. Best said York's A rating reflected its position as one of two companies providing "abstainers" car and non-smokers insurance in Ontario, Canada.

The rating agency said York has about C$108.9 million in assets and C$22.1 million in policy holders' surplus, on which it returned 32.9 percent in 1996. The company wrote 67.2 percent more in gross premiums, A.M. Best added.
A.M. Best said York's positive rating factors were partly offset by the same factors that affect Kingsway General.
